_doc: Low-confidence feedback loop. When the classifier is unsure the visual is already muted (see confidence.conf_min in mapping_config.json); this asks the viewer what the moment felt like at exactly those points, and the answers are later used to retrain on in-domain data. Served to clients via GET /feedback/config so there is one source of truth.
_trigger_doc: Ask only when category confidence is below this. Deliberately the same value as mapping_config confidence.conf_min, so we ask exactly when we are already visually signalling uncertainty.
_pacing_doc: Never interrupt viewing: one prompt at a time, auto-dismissing, rate limited. A prompt the viewer resents is worse than no data.
_quality_doc: Answers faster than this are treated as careless and dropped at retraining time.
question: 이 장면, 어떻게 느껴졌나요?
_question_doc: Asks how the moment FELT, not what the 'true' emotion was — a Deaf viewer cannot hear the ground truth, but can judge from context and expression, and perceived emotion is what this product exists to convey.
_holdout_doc: sarcasm is not a class in the AIHub label space. Collect it from the start, but keep it out of retraining until there are enough examples to add it as a new class responsibly.
_retention_doc: Unanswered records are pruned so the store cannot grow without bound. Audio is never stored — only the numeric feature vector, from which the voice cannot be reconstructed.
